note: WORK-UX-01: one role per layer, and the actions each role performs. An action carries its own setup (instructions, what it always reads, what it may change, tools, what it asks first, run phases) and the checks its work is reviewed against. Projects copy these defaults into revisioned `role` and `work_action` records and change them from Work › Roles. `type` is the work type the runner and guidance know. `routine` names the config/routines.json routine whose items this action takes. The exact tools and permissions per action are a first cut; the owner expects to refine them.

presets.note: Onboarding working styles only seed who takes each action. `agent` means the default agent profile; anything else goes to the person who created the project. They are never shown again.

roles.name: Product lead
roles.blurb: Shapes what to build and why: stories, acceptance and specs.
roles.instructions: Write for the personas in Product › Vision. Ask only questions whose answers change what gets built.

actions.name: Write acceptance
actions.description: Given/When/Then for stories that have none
actions.instructions: Each scenario must be checkable in a preview. Cover the open edges listed on the story.
actions.asks: Changing a story's title or phase
checks: Each scenario can be checked in a preview
The scenarios cover the story's open edges

actions.name: Draft answers to open questions
actions.description: Options and a recommendation; a person decides
actions.instructions: Offer two to four answers that differ in ways the owner cares about, and recommend one.
actions.asks: Always: the decision is a person's
checks: The answer is applied to the record it changes

actions.name: Write specs
actions.description: Problem, appetite, solution and numbered requirements
actions.instructions: One spec per increment of related stories. Number requirements; use WHEN clauses where a requirement is conditional.
actions.asks: Changing a phase or the roadmap
checks: Every requirement traces to a story
The appetite is stated

actions.name: Research
actions.instructions: Cite primary sources with the date you read them.
checks: Each claim cites a source

actions.name: Product drift check
actions.instructions: List stories whose built behaviour and acceptance disagree.
checks: Each finding names the story it concerns

roles.name: Design lead
roles.blurb: Keeps the design system coherent across every page.
roles.instructions: Propose new components rather than one-off styles.

actions.name: Evolve tokens and components
actions.description: New components rather than one-off styles
actions.asks: Changing a token more than one page uses
checks: Every page still reads well with the change

actions.name: Design system audit
actions.description: One-off styles and drift from tokens
checks: Each finding names the page it concerns

roles.name: Experience designer
roles.blurb: Turns stories into pages and the flows between them.
roles.instructions: Design from the stories a page realises; every linked story gets a place.

actions.name: Design pages
actions.description: Every linked story gets a place on the page
actions.instructions: Use the project's tokens and components. Offer options only when they differ in ways the owner cares about.
actions.asks: Removing a story from a page
checks: Every linked story has a place on the page

actions.name: Map flows
actions.description: How pages connect for each activity
checks: Every activity can be completed through the pages

actions.name: Accessibility sweep
checks: Each finding is recorded on its page

roles.name: Data architect
roles.blurb: Owns objects, operations and who may use them.
roles.instructions: Nothing above Platform names the stack. Objects are JSON Schema 2020-12; operations follow OpenAPI 3.1.

actions.name: Write object contracts
actions.description: Fields, required fields and states, with no stack names
actions.instructions: Required fields follow the stories that need them.
checks: The fields cover every story that needs the object
The contract names no tables, frameworks or languages

actions.name: Write API operations
checks: Each operation serves a story

actions.name: Set access rules
actions.description: Who may read and change each object
checks: Every object has a rule for each role

roles.name: Engineer
roles.blurb: Builds stories and keeps the code in step with the layers.
roles.instructions: Implement against the story's acceptance and the Data contract.

actions.name: Build stories
actions.description: One story per build; the preview must pass its acceptance
actions.instructions: One story per build. Name tests after the acceptance they check ("S4 · Given …"). Commit with the Aludel-Work and Implements trailers.
checks: The preview passes every acceptance scenario of the story

actions.name: Reconcile changed code
actions.description: Create, modify or remove code against the new revision
actions.instructions: Classify each linked unit as create, modify or remove against the new revision, then relink.
actions.asks: Removing a unit something still calls
checks: The code matches the record's new revision

actions.name: Configure services
actions.description: Name the effect, its cost and whether it can be undone
checks: The cost and how to undo it are stated

actions.name: Update dependencies
checks: Tests pass after the update

actions.name: Security audit
checks: Each finding has a severity and the record it concerns

roles.name: Reviewer
roles.blurb: Checks work against acceptance before it reaches you.
roles.instructions: Verify; don't assume. Flag anything you could not check.

actions.name: Check work against acceptance
actions.description: Pre-checks each criterion; a person makes the call
actions.instructions: For each check: look at its evidence, compare it with the check's source record, and say pass or flag with the evidence you used.
checks: Each verdict quotes its evidence
